title: Storage Collision in SapienCore
description: Insertion of 'userActiveClaimedQuantity' shifts existing state variable slots.
impact: Protocol-wide configuration corruption on upgrade.

title: Oracle Trust Assumption
description: Unconditional trust in ValidationOracle.getConsensus results.
impact: Financial loss if oracle is compromised or consensus is manipulated.

title: Missing Role Grant Logic
description: UPDATER_ROLE not granted between Core and Oracle during initialization.
impact: Deployment failure; protocol non-functional until manual intervention.

title: Storage Gap Inconsistency in ValidationOracle
description: Gap size increased without variable removal, inconsistent with gap management.
impact: Future storage collisions or inheritance issues.

title: Queue Pollution in ValidationOracle
description: Re-enqueued contributions add new slots without clearing stale ones.
impact: Validators claiming stale slots, wasted gas, sync issues.

title: Inflation Attack Risk in SapienVault
description: Missing initial 'dead' share minting for first depositor protection.
impact: First depositor vulnerable to donation-based inflation attack.

title: Validator Reward Rounding to Zero
description: Reward math rounds down to zero for small weights or low-decimal tokens.
impact: Loss of incentives for validators.

title: Inefficient Storage Deletion
description: Using 'delete' on arrays of structs in enqueueValidation.
impact: Potential block gas limit exhaustion.

title: Liveness Griefing via Reveal Delay
description: Validators can delay finalization by not revealing commits.
impact: Project progress stalled for up to 3 days.

title: Validator Queue Monopoly
description: Whales can fill the pending queue using high capacity.
impact: Centralization of consensus and censorship.

title: Reward Rate Manipulation (Sandwiching)
description: Funding projects during finalization changes reward rates.
impact: Extraction of value from earlier participants.

title: Unbounded Loops in SapienCore
description: Batch functions lack input array length limits.
impact: DoS for specific transactions if arrays are too large.

title: Unreclaimable Reward Dust
description: Rounding dust accumulates in Rewards contract with no withdrawal mechanism.
impact: Small amount of tokens permanently trapped.

title: Emergency Withdrawal Risk
description: totalAllocated does not track tokens in distributeReward.
impact: Admin might accidentally withdraw user-owed tokens.

title: Redundant Storage Gap in SapienVault
description: Excessive gap slots (49) reserved despite high inheritance.
impact: Code clutter and slight deployment gas increase.

title: Redundant Reward Logic
description: _calculateContributorReward called twice in _finalizeContribution.
impact: Small unnecessary gas expenditure.

title: Packing Opportunities
description: Structs use uint256 for small values like scores and timestamps.
impact: Increased SLOAD/SSTORE gas costs.

title: Strategic Non-Reveal
description: Validators may withhold reveals to influence weighted averages.
impact: Minor consensus bias.

title: Reputation Incentive Decoupling
description: Some consensus algorithms ignore reputation scores.
impact: Weakened long-term quality incentives.

title: Anti-dilution Behavior Change
description: Fees no longer count towards anti-dilution effective amounts.
impact: User confusion regarding funding requirements.
